evals.prompt: Write a Sui Move module called `test_project::demo` that demonstrates Move 2024 edition syntax features. Include: (1) A public struct Item with key and store abilities, having id (UID), name (String), and tags (vector<String>). (2) A public function `create` that uses method syntax on vector (vector::empty(), tags.push_back()) and string (b"hello".to_string()). (3) A public function `tag_count` that takes &Item and returns the length using method syntax (item.tags.length()). (4) A public function `destroy` that unpacks the Item using positional/named destructuring and calls id.delete(). Use Move 2024 edition module declaration with semicolon, no outer braces.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
Uses 2024 method syntax instead of function-call syntax
